title: Development diagnosis of state-content recovery versus CASM execution
question: When the selected integrated PLM configuration makes XOR the hardest operation, is the error concentrated in recovering queried latent bits from persistent state or in the fixed CASM computation over recovered bits?
hypothesis: The diagnostic will quantify the fraction of XOR errors occurring despite both queried state bits being correctly recovered, separating state-content loss from downstream Boolean execution error.

decision_rule.condition: if XOR execution error given both queried bits correct is substantial
decision_rule.licenses: downstream CASM/Boolean execution is a diagnosed contributor to XOR weakness on the development split
decision_rule.does_not_license: CASM is generally inadequate or that the same mechanism will fail on fresh held-out data

decision_rule.condition: if XOR state error rate dominates
decision_rule.licenses: state-content recovery is a diagnosed contributor to XOR weakness on the development split

interpretation_order: XOR execution conditional on correct bits
held_constant: same registered 32-composition development set used for capacity selection
sealed E2E-005 and E2E-006 held-out outcomes are not used
no auxiliary payload supervision is used during training
